prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on what you need (SEO, PPC, social, e‑commerce, B2B lead gen, creative/branding), your budget, industry, and whether you prefer a large full‑service firm or a smaller specialist. I can help you find the best match. Before that, here are practical steps and criteria so you can quickly narrow the field, plus an offer to build a tailored shortlist.

How to pick the best agency for your needs
- Define your primary goals: brand awareness, lead generation, sales, app installs, content/SEO growth, etc.  
- Set a budget range (monthly retainer or project amount) and desired timeline.  
- Decide scope: full service (strategy + creative + execution) or a specialist (SEO, paid media, social, CRO).  
- Consider industry experience — agencies that have worked with similar businesses tend to ramp up faster.  
- Look for measurable results: case studies, KPIs achieved, and client references.  
- Check credentials: Google Partner/Ads, Meta/LinkedIn certifications, technical platform experience (Shopify, HubSpot, Salesforce).  
- Read client reviews: Clutch, Google Business, UpCity, LinkedIn recommendations, and local awards.  
- Evaluate culture/fit: communication frequency, reporting style, team you’ll work with, and contract flexibility.

Questions to ask any agency before hiring
- What measurable results have you delivered for businesses like ours? Can you share case studies and references?  
- Which channels will you prioritize and why? What’s the expected timeline for results?  
- Who will be on our account team? Can we meet them?  
- What tools/platforms do you use for reporting and campaign management?  
- How do you measure and report ROI? What cadence of reporting and meetings do you propose?  
- What is your pricing model and minimum contract length? What are cancellation terms?  
- Can you provide a proposed scope and expected outcomes in writing?

Where to find top St. Louis agencies right now
- Directories and review sites: Clutch.co, UpCity, Google Business, LinkedIn.  
- Local sources: St. Louis Business Journal, local marketing meetups, referrals from other businesses in your industry.  
- Ask for warm introductions — a referral from a peer often gives the best insight into day‑to‑day work.

If you want, I can:
- Build a shortlist (3–6) of St. Louis agencies matched to your goals and budget.  
- Draft an RFP or outreach email you can send to prospective agencies.  
- Provide a comparison template to score proposals.

Tell me: what are your primary marketing goals, monthly budget range, and industry? I’ll put together a tailored shortlist and next steps.
